virtualLiveInformation.description:
■About the Special Merch Bundle
Introducing the Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH Special Merch Bundle!

This bundle includes the translated pamphlet for the Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH, a title and items for your Custom Profile.

■Please Note
The Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH itself will not be held.
You can watch archive recordings of Connect Shows using the Disc Shop and Theater.
Please inform yourself on the content of products before purchase.

■Special Merch Bundle Details
Availability
Dec. 11, 2023, 3:00 p.m. (PST) - Dec. 21, 2023, 2:59 p.m. (PST) 

Product Information
Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH Special Merch Bundle

Price:
• Paid Crystals x2,000

Maximum trades:
• 1 time

Contents:
• Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH Pamphlet
• Title: "Connect Show Vivid BAD SQUAD 1st CRASH"
• CRASH Glow Stick
• CRASH Show Logo Decal
• CRASH Key Visual Decal

*You can view the pamphlet under Menu > Items > Important Items.
*The CRASH Show Logo Decal and CRASH Key Visual Decal are items to be used in your Custom Profile.

• This bundle is available for a limited time only, but may be made available again in the future. Any potential future availability is currently TBD.
